faq.q: How much does San Diego County Car Accident Lawyer charge?
faq.a: San Diego County Car Accident Lawyer publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does San Diego County Car Accident Lawyer offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. San Diego County Car Accident Lawyer publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.a: San Diego County Car Accident Lawyer publishes one office, in El Cajon. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.
